approval_case.title: Complete the gate before debugging
approval_case.situation: An app-owned result is still missing, the accountable owner can continue in the background, and May lacks the supported closure command.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Route the held request to the reporting app owner. Review again when the generated report is verified. The app owner owns any closure-tool issue; Hao does not need to act.
